prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Create a striking square Steam Workshop animated-cover BACKPLATE for WILI, the moonshadow assassin from a Don't Starve Together character mod. This is artwork to have real game sprite animation composited onto its LOWER half afterward.
Input image 1 is the approved character identity/style, image 2 is the CURRENT exact weapon design, image 3 is the character style reference. Preserve her identity: jagged navy hair with ONE ivory forelock, low navy ponytail tied with dark red ribbon, sharp pale eye, black face mask, ragged black/navy cloak, silver crescent shoulder brooch. Traditional Don't Starve inspired crooked ink outlines, angular cut-paper silhouettes, economical flat paint, scratchy crosshatching; not glossy anime, not 3D.
Composition is CRITICAL: square 1024x1024. In the TOP RIGHT quarter only (x about 610-1000, y 30-430), a large dramatic three-quarter bust of Wili looking left/down toward the action. Her gloved hand holds her short silver curved knife in REVERSE grip, pommel above closed fist and blade hanging downward from little-finger side. Accurately use image 2 crescent guard with circular colored mosaic dark moon and ivory crescent, no hexagonal gem on the weapon. Keep entire recognizable face and knife within top 47% of image. A huge pale cold moon behind her upper-right silhouette. Backdrop midnight indigo forest, crooked black conifers at extreme sides.
Leave TOP LEFT (x40-610,y40-380) dark clean low-detail negative space for a large title to be typeset later. No text rendered anywhere.
LOWER 55% is an open side-view/isometric theatrical forest combat clearing, broadly legible cool gray-blue desaturated earth with subtle hand-ink grass near extreme lower corners, very few markings. Keep x90-940 y500-910 wide open, no characters, no enemies, no weapons or gems on the clearing. The empty arena is for authentic game sprites. Clear horizon transition at roughly y470. Floor slightly brighter than dark backdrop so black-outlined navy character sprites will stand out. Flat color background and broad shadow shapes, no tiny texture noise. Bottom 80 pixels somewhat dark for subtitle.
Elegant silver, black-blue sapphire moonlight, one restrained amber accent near moon edge. Strong thumbnail readability, premium game key art. No panel borders, no UI cards, no watermarks, no lettering, no logos.
gameplay_note: Foreground combat will be assembled from actual mod and game animation resources, not captured gameplay.
